title: String Matching in an Array
summary: Provide all strings from an array that are found within another string in the same array, in any order.
statement: Provide all strings from an array that are found within another string in the same array, in any order.
constraints: Return words occurring as a substring of another word in the same array.
Words are distinct; preserve input order.
reference_solution:
def substring_words(words):
 return [word for i,word in enumerate(words) if any(i!=j and word in other for j,other in enumerate(words))]
hints: Compare each word with every other word.
It qualifies if contained in at least one different element.
Keep the outer scan in original order.
The existential pair test exactly matches the required relation.
